author: Play On Tabletop
description:
Excited for the Las Vegas Open? You can now go to https://events.frontlinegaming.org/ and grab your tickets!
Frontline gaming is also North Americas one stop shop for all your tabletop gaming needs like Neoprene Battlemats, pre painted MDF terrain, tabletop gaming products or even commission painting services.  

The Warmistress returns to the Play on studios and she's back with some Astra Militarum to take on Mubin and some of the shiny new Adeptus Custodes models! Mubin brings a Solar Spearhead with more vehicles than he's used to playing. Will he have enough to take on The Warmistress her Grizzled company or will the 10000 be bested by the Emperor's finest?
